description: Find the feedback loops in your workspace: trace your scripts with writes blocked, add the human/AI steps, and see every loop, including the ones you never declared.
command.build: Build the graph (runs the traced scripts)
command.copyPrompt: Copy the request for your AI agent
config.allowNetwork: Let traced scripts reach the network. It is always recorded; blocked by default, so the script sees an error.
config.allowSubprocess: Let traced scripts start other programs. Blocked by default.
config.layoutBudget: Seconds spent searching each flow's layout during a build.
